The data sources for Saudi Arabia's water accounts include administrative records from government entities as well as censuses and statistical surveys conducted by the General Authority for Statistics. [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 18] [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 5] [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 15]
Specific government data sources include the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, Saudi Water Authority, National Water Company, National Center for Meteorology, Marafiq Company, MODON, and the Saudi Water Partnership Company. [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 18]
Specific surveys and censuses utilized are the General census of Population and Housing, National Accounts, Agricultural census, Waste and Water Economic Industrial Survey, and the Environment Household Survey. [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 18]
In terms of statistical scope, the reference area is a representative sample for Saudi Arabia, with time coverage spanning the years 2021, 2022, and 2023. [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 10]
The statistical unit and statistical population are both classified as not applicable for the water accounts. [Methodology and Quality Report of Water Accounts — page 10]

statements.text: The data sources for Saudi Arabia's water accounts include administrative records from government entities as well as censuses and statistical surveys conducted by the General Authority for Statistics.

Specific government data sources include the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, Saudi Water Authority, National Water Company, National Center for Meteorology, Marafiq Company, MODON, and the Saudi Water Partnership Company.

Specific surveys and censuses utilized are the General census of Population and Housing, National Accounts, Agricultural census, Waste and Water Economic Industrial Survey, and the Environment Household Survey.
In terms of statistical scope, the reference area is a representative sample for Saudi Arabia, with time coverage spanning the years 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The statistical unit and statistical population are both classified as not applicable for the water accounts.
